notes_for_editor: Four pages agree on the 1934 date, the 55-foot L-4 pole tower and the gone status. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page lists drive-up ruins, but no source confirms current road access, gate status or what the ruins look like, so access.level is left unset. No staffing, fire or removal date was found; the Idaho page says it has no documented staffing history. The Forest Lookouts page cites Kresek as its source for the 1934 entry, and that book was not read. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page also exists at a second URL (north-idaho-panhandle-region) with the same text. The brief's access field was 'unknown'; nothing here settles it.
